integrity: The proof derives the omega-operator explicitly on the indiscrete topology, proves KD45 soundness, and gives a formula-wise block simulation of arbitrary serial-transitive-Euclidean countermodels. The highly relevant 2026 halo-semantics source was inspected in full text around its omega characterization, Kripke non-representability theorem, completeness theorem, and fixed-space future-work discussion. Targeted literature and indexed-result searches did not locate an equivalent fixed-space KD45 theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the ordinary unimodal validity logic of the countably infinite indiscrete space under arbitrary valuations. It does not classify other non-T1 spaces or restricted valuation semantics, and it does not relationally represent the omega-accumulation operator.
title: KD45 without a Kripke operator on the countable indiscrete halo space
